mapper.select: SELECT id, username, status, todo, detail,priority, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM todos WHERE username = #{username} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC;
SELECT id, username, status, todo, detail,priority, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM todos WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (status,username,todo, detail,priority, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{status}, #{username}, #{todo}, #{detail}, #{priority}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET status=#{status}, todo = #{todo}, detail = #{detail},priority=#{priority}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
